architecture.title: Architecture Overview: The Determinism Wall & CQRS Separation
architecture.summary: The foundational premise: feed read path must never touch an LLM (< 50ms). CQRS separation between async content factory and Postgres read serving.

architecture.title: Generation Pipeline: LangGraph Fan-Out & Quota Governance
architecture.summary: Detailed breakdown of the LangGraph execution flow: topic planning, group-concurrent tier-sequential card generation, two-pass quality gate, and group-level persistence.

architecture.title: Content Model & Corpus Taxonomy
architecture.summary: Data contracts for Topics, Subtopics, Cards, Archetypes, and Quiz Questions. The card lifecycle and structural constraints.

architecture.title: Run 2 Benchmark: 5,004 Cards & The Concurrency Breakthrough
architecture.summary: Empirical benchmark across 40+ API keys. Eliminating the legacy semaphore bottleneck (ADR-0047) increased throughput from 16 to 130+ cards/min.

adrs.title: ADR-0028: Per-key-per-model quota grid with two-pool fallback ladder
adrs.summary: Transition from a flat API key list to a 2D (key × model) quota grid with independent thinking and generator fallback ladders.

adrs.title: ADR-0029: Questions join generator pool
adrs.summary: Moving question generation from the constrained thinking pool to the high-throughput generator pool.

adrs.title: ADR-0030: Two-pass, self-correcting quality gate
adrs.summary: Replacing discard-only validation with Pass 1 in-place topic/factual correction, local dedup, and Pass 2 difficulty verification.

adrs.title: ADR-0031: Verification feedback and per-tier gate durability
adrs.summary: Threading rejection feedback into subsequent generation runs and making gating durable at the subtopic-tier level.

adrs.title: ADR-0040: Serialize actual network calls per (key, model) cell
adrs.summary: Eliminating false 429 burst errors by locking same-cell network invocations while preserving full concurrency across independent grid cells.

adrs.title: ADR-0041: Per-group gate and persist
adrs.summary: Persisting cards and making them live in the feed as soon as their subtopic group finishes, removing global fan-in write bottlenecks.

adrs.title: ADR-0026: One-shot generation to completion
adrs.summary: Idempotent topic pipeline design ensuring interrupted runs safely pick up where they left off without duplicate generation.

adrs.title: ADR-0025: Batched LLM topic matching
adrs.summary: Two-stage topic deduplication: cheap local pgvector nearest-neighbor search followed by a single batched LLM classification call.

adrs.title: ADR-0047: Removal of legacy concurrency semaphore
adrs.summary: Removing the obsolete global asyncio.Semaphore(5) bottle-neck and delegating all rate limiting to the multi-key QuotaGovernor.

docs.title: Continuum System Architecture: Event-Sourced Directed Multigraph
docs.summary: Production continuity engine treating a film as an immutable event ledger in ClickHouse with multi-agent orchestration via Vertex AI.

docs.title: Product Specification: AI-Native Virtual Studio OS
docs.summary: Coordination model for Director, Producer, Writer, Actor, and Department Portals with bi-directional cascade invalidation.
